# The MUX reads dGPU but amdgpu still reports a connected panel (synthetic; should never happen): the panel wins,
# and the note says so.
fw mux=0 dgpu=0
drm card0 driver=amdgpu pci=0000:65:00.0 vendor=0x1002 device=0x150e class=0x038000 conn=eDP-1:connected
drm card1 driver=nouveau pci=0000:64:00.0 vendor=0x10de device=0x2f58 class=0x030000 conn=eDP-1:disconnected
render renderD128 driver=amdgpu pci=0000:65:00.0 vendor=0x1002 device=0x150e class=0x038000
render renderD129 driver=nouveau pci=0000:64:00.0 vendor=0x10de device=0x2f58 class=0x030000
pci 0000:64:00.0 driver=nouveau vendor=0x10de device=0x2f58 class=0x030000
pci 0000:65:00.0 driver=amdgpu vendor=0x1002 device=0x150e class=0x038000
